item.title: Villa Maria overcomes Archbishop Ryan in first round
item.description: LOWER GWYNEDD — The Archbishop Ryan girls basketball team feasted from the three-point line early in Saturday’s PIAA 5A firs-round matchup against Villa Maria. But it was famine in the third quarter and the Hurricanes took advantage to pull away for a 49-42 victory at Wissahickon High School. Bri Romeo led the way 14 points, Sophia Tray added 13 and Becca Croft chipped in with eight — all in the decisive third quarter.
